corrected_code:
@asynccontextmanager
async def lifespan(app: FastAPI):
    app.state.channel_manager = ChannelMemoryManager()
    await app.state.channel_manager.connect_datastore()
    yield
    await app.state.channel_manager.teardown()

app = FastAPI(lifespan=lifespan)

@app.get("/api/v1/events/channels/{channel_id}/backlog")
async def fetch_channel_event_backlog(
    channel_id: str,
    limit: int = 50,
    request: Request = None,
    current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_async_db)
):
    membership = await db.execute(
        select(ChannelMember).where(
            ChannelMember.channel_id == channel_id,
            ChannelMember.user_id == current_user.id
        )
    )
    if not membership.scalar_one_or_none():
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Not authorized to access channel backlog")
    channel_mgr = request.app.state.channel_manager
    events = await channel_mgr.get_cached_events(channel_id=channel_id, limit=limit)
    return {"channel_id": channel_id, "events": events}
